what: With the section pinned to the screen, it rests briefly (.36 share), then the cover panel layered over the section grows as a circle from bottom left (16% 100%) (3 share, power1.in) until it covers the whole section — when the circle is full, inside the cover [data-fx-part=after] rises at the .75 mark. The spot where a navy closing section roundly covers the FAQ

options.at: Center of the circle (the at of clip-path circle), default 16% 100%
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: Cover panel (overlaps inside the section with position:absolute) — if absent, nothing is applied
options.[data-fx-part=after]: What rises after fully covering inside the cover (optional)
